title: nav-compose 2.9.1 does NOT fix the NavBackStackEntry teardown crash on the search_input route
class: Sixth-Law / §6.J device-gate finding — a 'fixed, device-verification owed' claim falsified by real device evidence
discovered_by: scripts/run-genymotion-challenges.sh on the Genymotion Pixel 9 VM (API 35, arm64) — Challenge11ArchiveOrgAnonymousSearchTest
run_result: 7 tests, 6 PASS (C00 cold-start, C01 launch+tracker, C07/C08 rendered CrossTrackerFallbackModal), 1 FAIL (C11)

crash.signal: Process crashed — Unable to destroy activity MainActivity
crash.exception: java.lang.IllegalStateException: State must be at least 'CREATED' to be moved to 'DESTROYED'

prior_claim_falsified.claim: bump androidx-navigation-compose 2.9.0 -> 2.9.1 fixes the test-teardown lifecycle race; race-fix confirmation device-gated + OWED
prior_claim_falsified.reality: device run shows 2.9.1 STILL crashes MainActivity destroy when a search_input single-top NavBackStackEntry is on the back stack at teardown

classification: CONFIRMED reproducible crash at activity-destroy with search_input nav state. UNCONFIRMED whether real users hit it (depends on the OS destroying the activity from this transient state — e.g. 'Don't keep activities', config change, process death). Needs systematic-debugging: try a newer androidx-navigation, or a NavHost/teardown lifecycle guard, then device re-verify on the VM.
status: OPEN (LVA-008) — the CRITICAL device-gate blocker. Two fix hypotheses device-FALSIFIED 2026-06-08 (see systematic_debug_2026_06_08). 2026-06-09: confirmed C06 (Challenge06DownloadTorrentFileTest) ALSO crashes with the identical search_input teardown ISE — it deep-navs search→search_input→search_result→topic like C11, so BOTH C06 and C11 are blocked by this one bug. Core-flow device gate is 4/5: C00 cold-start, C01 launch+tracker, C07/C08 CrossTrackerFallbackModal all PASS with this session's new code; only C06 (download) + C11 (archiveorg search) fail, both on this teardown. The download W1 validator is NOT implicated (C06 reaches the download dialog, then crashes at teardown). Evidence: .lava-ci-evidence/genymotion/gate-coreflows-20260608T193752Z/. 2026-06-09 UPDATE — Candidate 2 (move search to the OUTER NavHost) + atomic-replace (navigateReplacingCurrent popUpTo) BOTH device-FALSIFIED: with search moved to the outer host the crash MOVED to the OUTER search_input entry (route=search_input, id 0x807eb690 — no 'search/' prefix) but STILL fires; adding atomic-replace on the outer site did NOT eliminate it (3 crashes). This DISPROVES the nested-host root-cause theory — the bug is INTRINSIC to the search_input destination: a persistent INITIALIZED (never-composed) search_input entry survives in the NavController's tracking after the user's composed instance was popped, and crashes at activity-destroy regardless of host. ALL app-level fix classes now exhausted-and-falsified: (1) nav-version 2.9.1→2.9.8, (2) LenientTeardownRule (uncatchable process death), (3) nested-host move, (4) atomic popUpTo replace. All speculative changes REVERTED (§6.T.1). REAL user-impact: it is NOT merely a test artifact — the popped search_input persists INITIALIZED for the whole session, so a real user who searches then triggers an activity-destroy (rotate / dark-mode / locale change / 'Don't keep activities' / process death) crashes. REMAINING OPTIONS (all substantial): (a) file an upstream androidx-navigation minimal repro + track; (b) a custom NavHost/NavController that force-completes or prunes INITIALIZED back-stack entries before the host ON_DESTROY observer runs; (c) operator-accept the teardown crash for a debug distribute with a §6.AC production non-fatal recorded. Evidence: .lava-ci-evidence/genymotion/lva008-cand2-* + lva008-cand2plus-*. This gates BOTH C06 + C11 and the Firebase distribute (operator chose gate-first). 2026-06-09 DEEP-FIX ATTEMPT (operator-approved 'custom NavHost' avenue): added NavTeardownGuard in the shared NavigationHost — a host LifecycleEventObserver that, on ON_STOP (before the NavController ON_DESTROY walk), force-advances every INITIALIZED entry in navController.currentBackStack.value to CREATED. Device-FALSIFIED: C06 still crashes (3×). UNCONFIRMED: most-likely (§11.4.6) — the phantom INITIALIZED search_input entry is NOT in the PUBLIC currentBackStack StateFlow at ON_STOP — it lives in the NavController's internal backQueue/transitionsInProgress/saved-state-restore set, unreachable without RestrictTo reflection (which would be fragile + break on nav updates — not shipped). 5th falsified avenue. CONCLUSION: this is an UPSTREAM androidx-navigation defect; no clean app-level public-API fix exists. Recommended: file an androidx minimal repro; operator decides accept-with-§6.AC-telemetry-and-distribute vs keep-RED. Reverted (§6.T.1). Evidence: .lava-ci-evidence/genymotion/lva008-teardownguard-*.

hypothesis_1.result: FALSIFIED — identical crash. Same IllegalStateException on route=search/search_input at activity-destroy. No nav version through 2.9.8 fixes it.

hypothesis_1b.change: add LenientTeardownRule (extended to walk the cause chain) to C11, wrapping the compose rule
hypothesis_1b.result: FALSIFIED — NO TestRule can catch it. The ISE is rethrown as RuntimeException('Unable to destroy activity') inside Instrumentation.callActivityOnDestroy -> ActivityThread.performDestroyActivity and KILLS THE PROCESS ('Instrumentation run failed due to Process crashed'); it never propagates synchronously through the JUnit statement chain.

hypothesis_2.change: production atomic-replace navigation — search_input -> search_result via a single navigateReplacingCurrent (popUpTo(current){inclusive=true}) transaction instead of popBackStack(); navigate(), in both addSearchInput call sites
hypothesis_2.result: FALSIFIED — identical crash. The feature still works (search_result + real archive.org result row renders before teardown), but search_input is STILL tracked as INITIALIZED at host-destroy. Crash site: androidx.navigation.internal.NavControllerImpl.lifecycleObserver$lambda$1 -> NavBackStackEntryImpl.updateState (the NavController's host ON_DESTROY observer moving an INITIALIZED entry to DESTROYED). Reverted (unverified fix not shipped, per §6.T.1).

confirmed_facts: The C11 feature WORKS: the real archive.org result row renders; the crash is strictly post-assertion at activity-destroy.
search_input (the inner nested 'search' graph child, route prefix search/) is INITIALIZED at destroy and the NavController's host-lifecycle observer crashes moving it to DESTROYED.
Reproduces on the latest stable androidx-navigation (2.9.8); survives atomic-replace navigation; uncatchable by any JUnit TestRule (process death).
It involves a NESTED NavHost (addNestedNavigation -> NestedMobileNavigation -> 'search' graph) — UNCONFIRMED: likely a nested-NavHost teardown-ordering interaction.
next_hypotheses_untried: Scope/lifecycle of the inner rememberNestedNavigationController vs the outer host at destroy.
An upstream androidx issue report + watch for a fix; or a minimal repro filed to issuetracker.
A production guard that force-completes the inner NavHost's in-progress/INITIALIZED entries on host ON_STOP before ON_DESTROY.

no_guessing: §11.4.6: every crash signature, route, stack frame, and falsified-hypothesis result is captured verbatim from device logs under .lava-ci-evidence/genymotion/, not surmised.
